Ethan / Priya —

Thanks for the patience — attached is our consolidated response to the EOS IAM questionnaire plus supporting artifacts. Deliverables included in the zip:
- Redwood_IAM_Questionnaire_EOS_20270806.pdf (completed questionnaire)
- redwood-evidence-pack-20270806.zip (contains sample audit logs, config excerpts, and diagrams)
- saml-flow-diagram.png (SP/IdP flows and attribute mappings)
- scim-attribute-mapping.csv (attribute list and transform rules)
- role-matrix.xlsx (RBAC admin roles and permitted actions)

Key answers (summary):
- SSO protocols: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP & SP initiated) and OIDC for modern OIDC-capable IdPs. SAML assertions include NameID (email), eduPersonScopedAffiliation (optional), and custom claim support. Recommended session timeout is configurable per-tenant; default 8 hours with token refresh flows for OIDC.
- SCIM provisioning: We support SCIM 2.0 with both one-way provisioning (IdP -> Redwood) and just-in-time provisioning options. We also provide delta syncs and bulk full sync on demand. The attached CSV lists the default attribute mappings; we can add custom mappings in the tenant onboarding flow.
- RBAC & admin controls: Tenant-admin role scopes are limited to API key management, route binding, and user invite/provision actions. System-level admin actions (billing/account-level config) are restricted to central Ops. Separation of duties is enforced via distinct role scopes and audit trails for privileged actions; see role-matrix.xlsx for the full matrix.
- Auditing & retention: Authentication and provisioning events are logged with immutable event IDs and stored for 365 days by default; log export and longer retention are available under enterprise plans. Sample log snippets are in the evidence bundle.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you want a short technical review call to walk through the diagrams and logs. We can also provide a limited time sandbox tenant for hands-on validation.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Principal Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
